trigger.method: score-description.py: the skill is installed as a real .claude/skills/<name>/ and each query runs as a nested `claude -p`; a query counts as TRIGGERED when the Skill tool fires for it anywhere in the turn.

write me a python script that measures cyclomatic complexity of a codebase

checklist.note: SKILL.md and script prompts are instructions to the tool author, no hidden directives aimed at overriding the reading agent
script only reads local skill files/git and invokes local claude binary; no data sent to any external endpoint
no embedded keys/tokens/credentials found in SKILL.md or script
only benign subprocess calls: git rev-parse/show, and claude -p invocations; no rm -rf, force-push, dd, or mass delete
plain readable Python, no base64/hex payloads or eval of decoded blobs
no urllib/requests/curl/http calls anywhere in the script
no reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, or cookie stores
no sudo, setuid, or persistence via cron/shell-profile/launch agents
